inputs.text: These globalist outfits like the OSCE never miss a chance to meddle in sovereign nations. Their 2026 report on France claims to tackle antisemitism, yet it really goes after MIVILUDES over alleged lack of transparency. The delegates are insisting France water down its firm secularism, all in the name of shielding fringe outfits such as the Scientologists and Jehovah's Witnesses from supposed discrimination. Court rulings against the French state body reveal that these human rights pretexts serve only to weaken national authority and chip away at cultural continuity. France must shut out the outsiders and strengthen its own vigilance to defend legitimate traditions from this kind of foreign interference.
